title: Cyclicity of ordinary trace between finite-dimensional spaces
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $A,B$ be finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $a:A\to B$ and $b:B\to A$ be $k$-linear maps. For ordinary trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace], $\operatorname{tr}(ba\mid A)=\operatorname{tr}(ab\mid B)$.

source.place: §1, p. 150, (T5), finite-dimensional trace identity used after restriction
